issues.title: Concurrency contract is externalized and unverified
issues.why: The spec explicitly offloads concurrency (WAL, busy_timeout, retries) to spec/13, but spec/04 is the 'single source of truth' for DB conventions. A mediocre coder will miss the spec/13 requirements.
issues.fix: Inline the mandatory SQLite PRAGMAs and retry logic constants directly into the 07-split-db-pattern.md or 02-schema-design.md.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'Smallest Possible Type' for SQLite
issues.why: SQLite uses dynamic typing (manifest typing); specifying SMALLINT vs INTEGER vs BIGINT has no storage impact in SQLite (it uses 1-8 bytes based on value), which contradicts the 'Key Sizing' table logic.
issues.fix: Clarify that for SQLite, INTEGER is the universal type, and sizing rules (SMALLINT/BIGINT) apply specifically to the MySQL fallback or logical validation.

issues.title: Dangling reference to 03-orm-and-views.md
issues.why: AC-10 and AC-11 reference specific sections (§1.1, §1.2) of 03-orm-and-views.md which is listed in the inventory but its content is not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Ensure the content of 03-orm-and-views.md is appended to the module context to resolve section references.
